description: Abstract class defining the core logic for subscription updating and data replication in a pub/sub system, used as a superclass for specific updater implementations.

classes.name: AbstractUpdater
classes.description: An abstract actor class managing subscription state, data consistency, and replication logic for pub/sub updates, intended to be subclassed for specific update strategies.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Base class for subscription-related requests, including subscribe, unsubscribe, and remove subscriber actions.

classes.name: Subscribe
classes.description: Request to subscribe to a set of topics with specified write consistency and acknowledgment options.

classes.name: Unsubscribe
classes.description: Request to unsubscribe from a set of topics.

classes.name: RemoveSubscriber
classes.description: Request to remove a subscriber from the pub/sub system, with options for acknowledgment and acknowledgment label declaration.

classes.name: SubAck
classes.description: Acknowledgment message for subscription requests, including the original request, sender, and sequence number.

classes.name: Clock
classes.description: Enum representing periodic clock ticks used to trigger data updates.

classes.name: DeclareAckLabels
classes.description: Message for declaring acknowledgment labels for a subscriber, convertible to a subscribe request.

classes.name: DDataOpSuccess
classes.description: Package-private class indicating successful completion of a distributed data operation, with payload, sequence number, and write consistency.

methods.name: ddataOpSuccess
methods.description: Abstract method to handle successful distributed data updates.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Abstract method to process subscribe requests.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Abstract method to process unsubscribe requests.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Abstract method to perform periodic update logic on clock ticks.

methods.name: updateFailure
methods.description: Handles failures during data updates, logging the error and marking local subscriptions as changed for retry.

methods.name: forceUpdate
methods.description: Determines probabilistically if the current update should be a forced update based on configuration.

methods.name: enqueueRequest
methods.description: Enqueues a subscription request into the update or acknowledgment queues, updating write consistency as needed.

methods.name: getSeqNr
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the last acknowledgment message generated.

methods.name: exportAwaitSubAck
methods.description: Exports queued acknowledgment messages up to a specified sequence number.

methods.name: moveAwaitUpdateToAwaitAcknowledge
methods.description: Moves pending update requests to the acknowledgment queue after a data write begins.

methods.name: handleDDataWriteResult
methods.description: Creates a callback function for handling the result of a distributed data write operation, notifying self of success or failure.

methods.name: logUnhandled
methods.description: Logs messages that are not explicitly handled by the actor.

methods.name: terminated
methods.description: Handles actor termination events, cleaning up subscriptions.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Handles requests to remove subscribers and unwatch them.

methods.name: doRemoveSubscriber
methods.description: Performs actual removal and cleanup of a subscriber actor.

methods.name: upgradeWriteConsistency
methods.description: Upgrades the write consistency level if the new level is more global than the current.

methods.name: isMoreConsistent
methods.description: Compares two write consistency levels, returning true if the first is more global (more consistent) than the second.

methods.name: rank
methods.description: Provides a ranking for write consistency levels from most local to most global.
